title: Official Game 7 Viewing Parties Across the NorthSide GTA
author: Landon Mulhall & Matthew Mulhall
excerpt: If you’re planning to watch tonight’s Game 7 of the World Series out in the community, a few NorthSide GTA towns are turning public spaces into Jays-blue fan zones. Here’s where the towns themselves are hosting official viewing parties.

body:
Looking for somewhere in the NorthSide to watch tonight’s **Game 7 of the World Series**? The energy couldn’t be higher, and a few local towns are turning public spaces into full-on Jays zones. Whether you’re in/near Newmarket or Aurora you can join fellow fans for one more unforgettable night of baseball under the lights.

**Official Municipal Viewing Parties — November 1, 2025**

Newmarket — The Nest (NewRoads Performing Arts Centre)

\*\*505 Pickering Crescent, Newmarket\*\*  

\*\*Doors open 7:30 p.m. • First pitch 8:00 p.m.\*\*

Hosted by the Town of Newmarket.  

\- Free popcorn and pizza (while supplies last)  

\- Licensed venue with drinks/snacks for purchase  

\- Family-friendly — no tickets needed

**Details:** <https://www.newmarket.ca/ThingsToDo/Pages/Recreation%20and%20Culture/Events/World-Series-Viewing-Party.aspx>

\---

**Aurora — Aurora Town Square**

\*\*50 Victoria Street, Aurora\*\*  

\*\*Doors open 7:30 p.m. • First pitch 8:00 p.m.\*\*

Town of Aurora public watch party.  

\- Free admission, family-friendly  

\- Giveaways/merch draws  

\- Food/refreshments available

**Details:** <https://www.aurora.ca/news/posts/aurora-to-host-blue-jays-world-series-watch-parties-at-town-square/>

***One last time this year — LET’S GO BLUE JAYS!***[](https://www.townofbwg.com/events)
